scenes.kick: THE SENTINEL REPORT · FOLLOW THE MONEY
scenes.title: Ohio's 2026 Senate race, read straight from the filings.
scenes.sub: Every figure is a filed FEC fact. Every card carries its caveat.

scenes.caption: of the contributions to Ohio's 16 federal campaigns came from PACs.
scenes.source_note: DELEG-01. Denominator is contributions (individuals + committees + party), not total receipts.

scenes.label: THE DENOMINATOR
scenes.quote: PAC share is measured against CONTRIBUTIONS — individuals plus committees plus party — never against receipts, which include loans and transfers. Delegation totals are a sum of separate committees; nobody controls them jointly.
scenes.source: FEC · fec.gov/data/ · card DELEG-01 · desk evidence cards, generated 2026-09-10
scenes.source_note: Caveat of DELEG-01, shown with its card as the desk rules require.

scenes.label: READ THIS WITH IT
scenes.quote: Schedule E is complete (3 of 25 pages). The outside-pressure multiple on this card is a CEILING, so it is not shown here. Spending is the sum of six filed committees, to within a dollar.
scenes.source: FEC · fec.gov/data/candidate/S6OH00163/ · card BROWN-01 · desk evidence cards, generated 2026-09-10
scenes.source_note: Caveat of BROWN-01, shown with its card as the desk rules require.

scenes.caption: Two candidates. Both Ohio Senate seats. Opposite directions.

scenes.label: READ THIS WITH IT
scenes.quote: Concentration is not intent. A state-focused committee is single-state by design.
scenes.source: FEC · fec.gov/data/committee/C00912865/ · card OH-FLYER-01 · desk evidence cards, generated 2026-09-10
scenes.source_note: Caveat of OH-FLYER-01, shown with its card as the desk rules require.

scenes.caption: $8,253,532 split five ways. 63% to the campaign.

scenes.label: READ THIS WITH IT
scenes.quote: A transfer is not a gift and not an endorsement. Whether a super PAC may participate in a candidate JFC is a question of FEC rules and advisory opinions this desk has NOT answered. Nothing here asserts a violation.
scenes.source: FEC · fec.gov/data/committee/C00896928/ · card TEAM-HUSTED-01 · desk evidence cards, generated 2026-09-10
scenes.source_note: Caveat of TEAM-HUSTED-01, shown with its card as the desk rules require.

scenes.caption: of everything it raised went to one media firm.
scenes.sub: $2,755,532 to SRCP MEDIA INC. of $3,636,779 raised.

scenes.label: A QUESTION, NOT A FINDING
scenes.quote: A joint fundraiser legitimately pays the COST of raising money and allocates it among participants. 'MEDIA' does not say whether this is fundraising solicitation or campaign advertising, and the purpose code cannot distinguish them. THIS IS A QUESTION, NOT A FINDING.
scenes.source: FEC · fec.gov/data/committee/C00937797/ · card HV-01 · desk evidence cards, generated 2026-09-10
scenes.source_note: Caveat of HV-01, shown with its card as the desk rules require.

scenes.caption: spent attacking her for every dollar spent defending her.

scenes.label: READ THIS WITH IT
scenes.quote: The SMALLER ratio is often the larger operation — Brown is 10:1 on $13.5m, which is 136x this money. A ratio describes balance, not size.
scenes.source: FEC · fec.gov/data/candidate/H4FL20023/ · card WS-01 · desk evidence cards, generated 2026-09-10
scenes.source_note: Caveat of WS-01, shown with its card as the desk rules require.

scenes.title: We tried to break our own best finding. We succeeded five times.
scenes.sub: Every one was caught by dividing, or by reading the same figure from another register.

scenes.caption: The retracted figure, and the one the filings support.
scenes.sub: It divided by a truncated sample, not the committee total.

scenes.title: Documents and dates. No characterization.

scenes.cta: Spread truth — but make sure it is truth.
